game: Resident Evil Resistance, Windows PC Route
target: Spoiler-free completion of every live mode, map, roster slot, rank gate, skill variant, match condition, weapon, equipment row, deck card, rotating mission, cosmetic entry, and final system audit

areas.name: PC Route and Online Status
areas.location_cue: The Steam library entry, separate multiplayer launcher, and online main menu.
areas.note: Current play is possible but population-dependent; an arranged group is the dependable route.

levels.1: Use the native PC release tied to the companion game.
levels.2: Install the separate Resistance client from the same Steam library entitlement.
levels.3: Use the native Windows client; no secondary platform or emulation pass adds exclusive content. The client needs a continuous network connection, so confirm sign-in before organizing players.

levels.1: The multiplayer client is attached to another library purchase.
levels.2: Check the Steam library rather than searching for a separate standalone purchase.
levels.3: Resistance is supplied with the Windows release of Resident Evil 3. If the store page is unlisted, install it from the owned library entry; do not obtain an unofficial client.

levels.1: Test the online menu before planning a long completion session.
levels.2: Open Quick Match and verify that matchmaking begins without a service error.
levels.3: As of 2026-07-15, matches still use peer hosting and no dedicated match server is required. Availability depends on other players and platform authentication, so record any new service notice before proceeding.

levels.1: A full private group removes the population bottleneck.
levels.2: Prepare four Survivor players and one Mastermind player before opening Custom Game.
levels.3: Use an arranged group of five for map, skill, and match-condition checks. Rotate the solo Mastermind role after each planned set, and use Quick Match separately whenever rank, RP, or mission credit must be recorded.

levels.1: Keep a dated record of online-only progress.
levels.2: Capture ranks, owned equipment, deck cards, and cosmetic totals after each session.
levels.3: Copy the local save and configuration, then retain dated menu and results captures. Server-side records cannot be reconstructed from the pack if online access changes later.

levels.1: Make sure every late content category appears in the menus.
levels.2: Confirm that all seven maps, seven Survivor slots, and five Mastermind slots are present.
levels.3: Update to the final PC build. Official content and balance support ended in October 2020; the complete build includes the late maps, added equipment, final card set, and final cosmetic catalogue.

save_backup.title: Preserve the current online record
save_backup.why: A rotation or network window can change before the same condition returns.
save_backup.detail: Capture the mission panel and result screen, then copy the local save and configuration before leaving this rotation.

areas.name: Tutorials, Practice, and Match Modes
areas.location_cue: The mode selector containing Tutorial, Practice, Quick Match, and Custom Game.
areas.note: Private play is best for checks; live matchmaking is used for persistent rewards.

levels.1: Learn the team role before joining a live lobby.
levels.2: Choose Tutorial from the main menu and select the Survivor lesson.
levels.3: Complete every prompted movement, item, objective, and exit step until the tutorial returns to the menu with a clear state.

levels.1: Learn the camera role before building a deck.
levels.2: Choose Tutorial from the main menu and select the Mastermind lesson.
levels.3: Complete every camera, card, energy, control, and environmental-interaction prompt until the tutorial records completion.

levels.1: Use the offline-style sandbox to test controls safely.
levels.2: Open Practice, choose the Survivor side, and load one map.
levels.3: Adjust the available practice parameters, enter the map, purchase an item, trigger both active skill types, and finish or exit only after the controls are confirmed.

levels.1: Test deck placement without holding up other players.
levels.2: Open Practice, choose the Mastermind side, and load one map.
levels.3: Cycle cameras, spend bio energy, place each available card type, use an environmental control, and deploy the ultimate once before leaving practice.

levels.1: Use public matchmaking for progression that private play may not grant.
levels.2: Finish one Quick Match while queued as a Survivor.
levels.3: Select the Survivor role, complete the entire match without disconnecting, and confirm that rank, RP, and mission counters update on the results screen.

levels.1: The solo role has its own progression ledger.
levels.2: Finish one Quick Match while queued as the Mastermind.
levels.3: Select the Mastermind role, remain host through the result, and verify rank, RP, and active mission progress before returning to matchmaking.

levels.1: One queue option trades role certainty for a bonus.
levels.2: Complete one match using the Random role option.
levels.3: Choose Random under Quick Match, accept whichever role is assigned, finish normally, and confirm the role-selection RP bonus on the result.

levels.1: Use a private lobby for controlled mechanical checks.
levels.2: Create a Custom Game and fill all five player positions.
levels.3: Set a map, assign four players to the team side and one to the camera side, complete the match, then rotate roles. Do not assume private results award rank or RP; verify those in Quick Match.

levels.1: The solo role can prepare environmental layouts in advance.
levels.2: Reach rank 5 with any Mastermind slot, then open the map-preset editor.
levels.3: Save one valid preset for every map. Place the permitted objects in each area, keep within its point allowance, and load each preset once in a Custom Game to confirm it is selectable.

areas.name: Downtown
areas.location_cue: The loading card and preset selector labelled Downtown.
areas.note: Both roles and the editable preset are checked without revealing match events in advance.

levels.1: Learn the supply stations and objective routes before attempting a clean result.
levels.2: Finish Downtown on the four-player side.
levels.3: Select Downtown in Custom Game, complete all three mechanical areas, gather every teammate at the final exit, and cross before the clock expires.

levels.1: Test the fixed cameras and environmental controls before defending the whole layout.
levels.2: Finish Downtown on the solo camera side.
levels.3: Select Downtown in Custom Game, use cameras and the saved preset across all reached areas, and reduce the shared timer to zero before the team completes the final exit.

levels.1: Prepare a legal layout rather than relying only on the default arrangement.
levels.2: Create and save a custom preset for Downtown.
levels.3: Open the preset editor after reaching Mastermind rank 5 on any slot, configure every available area of Downtown, save without an allowance error, then load that preset in Custom Game.

areas.note: Roster identities stay hidden; rank, loadout, and skill checks use menu positions only.

levels.1: Keep this loadout in the live rotation until every variant opens.
levels.2: Raise Survivor Slot #1 to rank 20.
levels.3: Finish Quick Matches with Survivor Slot #1 until rank 20 is recorded. Open all four skill families and verify that every final variant is selectable.

levels.1: A long-term appearance waits beyond the skill cap.
levels.2: Raise Survivor Slot #1 to rank 50.
levels.3: Continue completed Quick Matches with Survivor Slot #1 through rank 50, then open Customize and confirm the gold appearance is owned and can be equipped.

levels.1: Protect all four players through the final gathering point.
levels.2: Complete a match with the whole team escaping while using Survivor Slot #1.
levels.3: Use an arranged match, keep all four players active, revive anyone who is downed, gather everyone inside the final exit boundary, and cross together before time expires.

areas.location_cue: The Missions panel beside matchmaking, with its remaining-time display and claim state.
areas.note: Current templates are completed during their window; removed templates are labelled archival-only.

levels.1: Check the active daily or weekly panel before starting the next match.
levels.2: When the panel shows the condition 'fever uses 10', complete it before the rotation changes.
levels.3: Pin the active condition 'fever uses 10', use Quick Match unless the panel explicitly credits another mode, finish every required match, claim the RP or cosmetic chest, and capture the claimed state before reset.

areas.name: Final System Audit
areas.location_cue: The supply marker during matches and the completed Customize catalogues afterward.
areas.note: The closing audit covers shipped systems only; absent campaign structures are not padded.

levels.1: Watch the map when a marked supply carrier appears.
levels.2: Defeat the marked supply carrier before the solo player protects it.
levels.3: Follow the map marker, defeat the supply carrier, collect its dropped special item, use that item before the match ends, and confirm any active mission counter.

levels.1: A temporary marked unit can reward the solo side if kept active.
levels.2: Protect one marked supply carrier until its reward becomes available.
levels.3: Track the marked carrier through cameras, lock nearby doors, deploy cards along the approach, prevent its defeat, then use the awarded special card before finishing the match.

levels.1: Save appearance spending until the equipment catalogue is stable.
levels.2: Earn or spend 50,000 RP for one Cosmetic Chest and open it.
levels.3: Complete the active mission claims or use earned RP, open one 50,000-RP Cosmetic Chest, note the random category and row, then confirm the same row is marked owned in Customize.

levels.1: A paid multiplier is optional and should never replace normal completion.
levels.2: Open the RP Booster shop and its usage-history panel.
levels.3: If a lawful booster entitlement already exists, enable one before Quick Match, finish the match, and verify its consumption in usage history. Do not buy a booster merely to mark this optional system complete.

levels.1: Begin with the least expensive team-side equipment pool.
levels.2: Open the low-tier Survivor pool at 3,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 35.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Survivor > Low. Continue beyond the 35-row baseline if the final client still shows unowned late additions, and stop only when that live tier is exhausted.

levels.1: Move to the middle team-side pool after the low tier is empty.
levels.2: Open the mid-tier Survivor pool at 8,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 31.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Survivor > Mid. Continue beyond the 31-row baseline if the final client shows a late addition, and stop only when no mid-tier row remains locked.

levels.1: Finish the most expensive team-side pool last.
levels.2: Open the high-tier Survivor pool at 20,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 33.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Survivor > High. Continue beyond the 33-row baseline if the final client shows a late addition, and stop only when no high-tier row remains locked.

levels.1: Begin with the least expensive solo-side equipment pool.
levels.2: Open the low-tier Mastermind pool at 3,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 30.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Mastermind > Low. Continue beyond the 30-row baseline if the final client shows a late addition, and stop only when that live tier is exhausted.

levels.1: Move to the middle solo-side pool after the low tier is empty.
levels.2: Open the mid-tier Mastermind pool at 8,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 31.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Mastermind > Mid. Continue beyond the 31-row baseline if the final client shows a late addition, and stop only when no mid-tier row remains locked.

levels.1: Finish the most expensive solo-side pool last.
levels.2: Open the high-tier Mastermind pool at 20,000 RP per chest; the preserved baseline contains 34.
levels.3: Use earned RP in Shop > Equipment Chest > Mastermind > High. Continue beyond the 34-row baseline if the final client shows a late addition, and stop only when no high-tier row remains locked.

levels.1: Finish the chest catalogue before spending RP only on appearances.
levels.2: Confirm every Survivor and Mastermind equipment row is marked owned.
levels.3: Compare all eight equipment category tabs against this pack's row counts. Purchase the remaining chest tiers, clear every unowned mark, and save one legal four-item build for each roster slot.

levels.1: Finish every rank gate before finalizing solo-role decks.
levels.2: Confirm every standard and exclusive card row is selectable.
levels.3: Reach rank 20 on all five Mastermind slots, inspect every card category, clear all rank locks, and use each row once across saved decks and arranged matches.

levels.1: Use the category totals rather than trusting a single chest counter.
levels.2: Confirm every currently obtainable customization row is owned or documented as entitlement-only.
levels.3: Compare each cosmetic tab with this pack, exhaust random Cosmetic Chests, verify platform in-game-item entitlements, and record any catalogue-only row whose original route is no longer preserved.
